about: Strapi 5's GraphQL content API, checked against strapi-php's GraphQL plugin. Run on an empty database: seeds over REST in order, then each query and mutation in order, with strapi-populate-vectors.mjs. A step's graphql is posted to /graphql with its variables. publishedAt is compared as present or absent; documentId, id and the timestamps are left out.

reads.name: a list sends every scalar it is asked for
reads.graphql: { books(sort: "title") { title pages rating inStock publishedOn releasedAt publishedAt } }

reads.name: one document by documentId, with its components
reads.graphql: { book(documentId: "@books:Alpha") { title price { minor currency } editions { amount unit } } }

reads.name: a document that does not exist is null
reads.graphql: { book(documentId: "nope") { title } }

reads.name: relations, to one and to many
reads.graphql: { books(sort: "title") { title author { name } genres(sort: "name") { name } topic { name } } }

reads.name: a relation's own filters, sort and pagination
reads.graphql: { book(documentId: "@books:Alpha") { genres(filters: { name: { startsWith: "F" } }) { name } desc: genres_connection(sort: "name:desc") { nodes { name } } } }

reads.name: a relation's pagination
reads.graphql: { author(documentId: "@authors:Ann") { name books(pagination: { limit: 1 }) { title } } }

reads.name: the inverse side of a relation
reads.graphql: { authors(sort: "name") { name books { title } books_connection { nodes { title } } } }

reads.name: a connection sends its page
reads.graphql: { books_connection(sort: "title", pagination: { page: 2, pageSize: 2 }) { nodes { title } pageInfo { page pageSize pageCount total } } }

reads.name: offset pagination
reads.graphql: { books_connection(sort: "title", pagination: { start: 1, limit: 1 }) { nodes { title } pageInfo { page pageSize pageCount total } } }

reads.name: both kinds of pagination at once are refused
reads.graphql: { books(pagination: { page: 1, limit: 2 }) { title } }

reads.name: filters on scalars
reads.graphql: { books(filters: { pages: { gte: 100 }, title: { containsi: "a" } }, sort: "title") { title } }

reads.name: logical filters
reads.graphql: { books(filters: { or: [{ title: { eq: "Gamma" } }, { pages: { gt: 200 } }] }, sort: "title") { title } }

reads.name: not
reads.graphql: { books(filters: { not: { title: { eq: "Alpha" } } }, sort: "title") { title } }

reads.name: filters through a relation
reads.graphql: { books(filters: { author: { name: { eq: "Bob" } } }) { title } }

reads.name: filters through a component
reads.graphql: { books(filters: { price: { currency: { eq: "EUR" } } }) { title } }

reads.name: filters with in, null and between
reads.graphql: { a: books(filters: { title: { in: ["Alpha", "Gamma"] } }, sort: "title") { title } b: books(filters: { rating: { null: true } }, sort: "title") { title } c: books(filters: { pages: { between: [60, 260] } }, sort: "title") { title } }

reads.name: sort by several keys and descending
reads.graphql: { books(sort: ["pages:desc", "title"]) { title } }

reads.name: an unknown sort key is refused
reads.graphql: { books(sort: "nope:asc") { title } }

reads.name: a field the type does not have fails validation
reads.graphql: { books { nope } }

reads.name: variables
reads.graphql: query Find($title: String!) { books(filters: { title: { eq: $title } }) { title pages } }

reads.name: drafts are left out unless the status asks for them
reads.graphql: { published: posts(sort: "title") { title publishedAt } drafts: posts(status: DRAFT, sort: "title") { title publishedAt author { name } } }

reads.name: a locale
reads.graphql: { en: articles { title code locale } fr: articles(locale: "fr") { title code locale } }

reads.name: a document's other locales
reads.graphql: { articles { title localizations { title locale } } }

reads.name: a dynamic zone, item by item
reads.graphql: { landings { title blocks { __typename ... on ComponentSharedHero { heading price { minor currency } } ... on ComponentSharedQuantity { amount unit } } } }

reads.name: aliases and typename
reads.graphql: { first: book(documentId: "@books:Alpha") { __typename name: title } }

writes.name: create a document with components and relations
writes.graphql: mutation { createBook(data: { title: "Delta", pages: 10, price: { minor: 5, currency: "USD" }, editions: [{ amount: 3, unit: "g" }], author: "@authors:Bob", genres: ["@genres:Poetry"] }) { documentId title pages price { minor currency } editions { amount unit } author { name } genres { name } } }

writes.name: create with variables
writes.graphql: mutation Make($data: BookInput!) { createBook(data: $data) { documentId title inStock } }

writes.name: update a document
writes.graphql: mutation { updateBook(documentId: "@books:Delta", data: { pages: 11, genres: [] }) { title pages genres { name } author { name } } }

writes.name: update a document that does not exist
create a draft
writes.graphql: mutation { createPost(data: { title: "Soon" }, status: DRAFT) { documentId title publishedAt } }

writes.name: publish it by updating with the published status
writes.graphql: mutation { updatePost(documentId: "@posts:Soon", data: { views: 3 }, status: PUBLISHED) { title views publishedAt } }

writes.name: create in a locale
writes.graphql: mutation { updateArticle(documentId: "@articles:Hello", data: { title: "Hallo" }, locale: "fr") { title code locale } }

writes.name: write a dynamic zone
writes.graphql: mutation { updateLanding(documentId: "@landings:Home", data: { blocks: [{ __typename: "ComponentSharedQuantity", amount: 9, unit: "g" }, { __typename: "ComponentSharedHero", heading: "New" }] }) { blocks { __typename ... on ComponentSharedHero { heading } ... on ComponentSharedQuantity { amount unit } } } }

writes.name: a zone item naming no component of the zone is refused
writes.graphql: mutation { updateLanding(documentId: "@landings:Home", data: { blocks: [{ __typename: "ComponentSharedMoney", minor: 1 }] }) { title } }
